relations.statement: A ValidityReduction maps a source predicate into proposal validity, preserving the predicate exactly: hard x iff valid (f x).
relations.hypotheses: f : HardInput -> Proposal with hard x <-> valid (f x)

relations.statement: The allowed proposal deciders are closed under precomposition with the reduction map.
relations.hypotheses: allowedProposal d implies allowedHard (d composed with f)

lemmas.statement: If hard has NoTotalDecider under allowedHard, the reduction preserves the predicate, and allowedProposal is closed under reduction, then valid has NoTotalDecider under allowedProposal.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem target {HardInput Proposal : Type} {hard : HardInput -> Prop} {valid : Proposal -> Prop} {allowedHard : (HardInput -> Bool) -> Prop} {allowedProposal : (Proposal -> Bool) -> Prop} : True := by sorry

near_misses.claim: Dropping closure under precomposition still yields no proposal decider.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Without closure, a proposal decider need not yield an allowed source decider, so the transfer fails.

near_misses.claim: A one-way implication hard x -> valid (f x) suffices for transport.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Exact preservation (iff) is required so that a decider for valid composed with f decides hard.
